question: In a common rail diesel injection system, what is the primary function of the pressure accumulator (rail)?
options: To filter fuel before injection
To maintain a constant high fuel pressure available for all injectors
To regulate the quantity of fuel delivered per stroke
To cool the fuel before it enters the injectors

question: Which diagnostic trouble code (DTC) category indicates a fault that is currently active and affecting vehicle operation?
options: Pending code
Historical code
Permanent code
Type B code

question: When performing a cylinder balance test on a gasoline direct injection engine, what does a significant RPM drop on one cylinder indicate?
options: That cylinder is producing more power than the others
That cylinder is contributing normally to engine output
That cylinder has a fault reducing its power contribution
That the ignition timing is advanced on that cylinder

question: In an electronically controlled automatic transmission, what sensor provides the TCM with input shaft speed data to calculate gear ratio and detect slip?
options: Throttle position sensor
Turbine speed sensor
Vehicle speed sensor
Mass airflow sensor

question: A vehicle exhibits excessive negative camber on both front wheels after a collision. Which suspension component is most likely bent?
options: Tie rod end
Stabilizer bar link
Strut tower or control arm
Wheel bearing hub

question: What is the purpose of the pre-charge resistor in a hybrid electric vehicle's high-voltage system during power-up?
options: To boost voltage to the drive motor during startup
To limit inrush current to the inverter capacitors and prevent damage
To regulate battery temperature during initial operation
To balance cell voltages within the high-voltage battery pack

question: In a variable valve timing (VVT) system using oil control valves (OCV), what condition would cause retarded camshaft timing to be fixed in the advanced position?
options: Low engine oil pressure due to worn oil pump
Stuck-open OCV allowing constant oil flow to the advance chamber
Broken timing chain causing chain stretch
Faulty throttle position sensor signal

question: Which welding technique is recommended when performing structural MIG welding on high-strength steel (HSS) body panels to avoid heat distortion and weakening?
options: Continuous bead welding at maximum amperage
Stitch or plug welding with appropriate inter-pass cooling
Oxy-acetylene fusion welding
TIG welding with filler rod at slow travel speed

question: A brake system shows a spongy pedal feel after bleeding. What is the most likely remaining cause?
options: Brake fluid contaminated with petroleum product
Air remaining in the ABS hydraulic control unit
Worn brake pad friction material
Seized caliper guide pins

question: In a CAN bus network, what is the significance of the dominant state overriding the recessive state during bus arbitration?
options: It allows the highest-priority message to gain control of the bus without collision
It indicates a short circuit fault in the network wiring
It triggers the gateway module to reset all connected ECUs
It causes all modules to enter a listen-only diagnostic mode

question: When diagnosing an AC refrigeration system, high pressure on both high and low sides with poor cooling indicates which fault?
options: Refrigerant undercharge
Blocked expansion valve in closed position
Non-condensable gases (air) in the system
Faulty compressor with internal bypass

question: What does a lambda (λ) value greater than 1.0 indicate about the air-fuel mixture in a gasoline engine?
options: A rich mixture with excess fuel
A stoichiometric mixture
A lean mixture with excess air
An incomplete combustion condition due to fuel flooding

question: In an electronic power steering (EPS) system, which sensor provides the primary input to determine the magnitude of steering assist required?
options: Vehicle speed sensor
Steering angle sensor
Torque sensor on the steering column
Yaw rate sensor

question: What is the purpose of the isolation test performed on a high-voltage hybrid or electric vehicle system before maintenance?
options: To verify the high-voltage battery state of charge
To confirm that high-voltage circuits are isolated from the vehicle chassis ground
To test the resistance of individual battery cells
To measure the maximum current output of the inverter

question: During a fuel injector flow test, one injector delivers significantly less fuel volume than the specification. After ruling out electrical faults, what is the most appropriate corrective action?
options: Increase fuel rail pressure to compensate for the flow deficit
Clean or replace the fuel injector to restore correct fuel delivery
Recalibrate the ECU fuel trim tables to adjust for the variance
Install a larger fuel pump to increase system pressure
